about: The merge build (report 08): the fact-check overlay and the nine harvest partitions on top of the app sources. Precedence is the order below: analyst decisions, then the fact-check files, then the harvest partitions (the founders' partition first), then the app files (Suspected). On a contested single-valued fact the first value is accepted and every other value is kept as an alternative; identity across files is decided by identity.py (QID, then enwiki title, then folded name + birth year; never name alone). Paths with base 'loom' are relative to the proto folder, 'proto' to proto/ingest, the rest to --src (the unpacked upload).
grade_reason: Unattributed compilation inside the uploaded app: no citations, notes read as a model's paraphrase of Wikipedia (x3d.onto GLOSSARY: a model's paraphrase of a page is S). The record is transcribed exactly (sha256, locator, verbatim quote); the fact it states is Suspected until a tool checks it.

sources.role: graded analyst decisions that resolve error gates; first in precedence; every overridden value stays as an alternative
sources.grade_reason: Model recall by the analyst, not checked against a source (wikidata.org was refused by the egress proxy). Suspected until a tool confirms it.

sources.role: fact-check overlay: corrected and expanded records (report 03)
sources.grade_reason: Corrected records written by the fact-check analyst (report 03) from pages fetched with WebFetch in an earlier session; the pages were not saved or hashed here, so one record is at most Likely: its own confidence can lower that, never raise it. Confirmed needs a second, independent source family agreeing (build.Builder.grade).
